rationale: Price has slipped below both the 5-min VWAP ($12.00) and the 9-EMA ($12.02), which were the two dynamic supports underpinning the long thesis; the most recent candle printed the lowest close since entry on the highest post-entry volume (16,335), suggesting sellers are stepping in rather than buyers absorbing. The setup's edge is functionally exhausted even though the hard invalidation at $11.94 hasn't been breached, and locking in a minimal loss now is preferable to risking further deterioration toward that level.
